subject: rabbit
name: 小兔子
label: 侧身跳跃的兔子
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One natural rabbit hopping in a side three-quarter view, swept-back ears, separated long hind legs, small rounded tail, gentle expressive face.
Important rendering constraint: pure clean black contour illustration, NOT an engraving. Smooth blank white interiors. Only the silhouette and a few broad structural interior lines, absolutely no hair strokes, fur texture, feather texture, hatching, gray shading or tonal fills. Keep a full 12 percent margin around the complete animal.
